About the AWP | Graphite

High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils. A predator is a predator, no matter the environment The AWP | Graphite is a Classified-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Graphite finish on the AWP. With a Classified rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.64% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The AWP | Graphite can be unboxed from the Operation Bravo Case. It belongs to the Bravo Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.12. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The AWP | Graphite (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $234.37, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $218.17 (Minimal Wear) to $234.37 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The AWP | Graphite has a community rating of 3.8 out of 5 based on 219 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among AWP skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the AWP | Graphite?

Factory New (FN) AWP | Graphite skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. This skin has a restricted float range (0.00-0.12), meaning Battle-Scarred versions don't exist. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Graphite pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the AWP | Graphite worth the price?

The AWP | Graphite sits in the mid-to-high price bracket. It features a distinctive Graphite design that stands out in-game and maintains good trading liquidity. It's part of the The Bravo Collection, obtainable from the Operation Bravo Case, which adds to its collectible appeal. For players who main the AWP, this skin offers an excellent balance of visual appeal and investment stability compared to budget alternatives.

What is the float value range for the AWP | Graphite?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.12, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the AWP | Graphite?

Prices for the AWP | Graphite vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the Operation Bravo Case or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Can I use the AWP | Graphite in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the AWP | Graphite are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.
